question: Should OpenClaw expose localized command descriptions as an additive Gateway and plugin-facing protocol field, and if so, what locale ownership and compatibility contract should it guarantee?
rationale: This is a new cross-client protocol and plugin API surface, not a mechanical localization repair; implementation review cannot safely choose its permanent contract without owner intent.

options.title: Approve a bounded protocol contract
options.body: Confirm that `descriptionLocalizations` is the supported additive command-catalog API and require documented locale, fallback, and compatibility behavior before merge.

options.title: Keep command descriptions canonical
options.body: Retain the existing protocol description and localize only client-owned presentation until a separately approved protocol design exists.

options.title: Split protocol direction from readiness work
options.body: Move the command and plugin metadata API changes into a narrowly owned RFC/PR while retaining only independently approved readiness work.

recommendation.title: Approve a bounded protocol contract
recommendation.body: Confirm that `descriptionLocalizations` is the supported additive command-catalog API and require documented locale, fallback, and compatibility behavior before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The exact Gateway and command-registry feature owner could not be attributed safely from the available read-only history access.
